import re

# Test various inputs
test_cases = [
    'Hello,  World!',
    'Hello!!!World',
    'a,b,c,d',
    '...test...',
]

def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")

for test in test_cases:
    result = slugify(test)
    print(f"{repr(test):25} -> {repr(result)}")
EOF
